technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term bullish structure with price above all major MAs and strong trend, but intermediate momentum is overbought with bearish MACD histogram and stochastic extremes, creating conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal with small position sizes, providing no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational revenues, with earnings event in 29 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (price above all major MAs, EMA 50/200 bullish, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 132.09.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate momentum is severely overbought (stochastic, Williams %R) with bearish MACD histogram, earnings binary risk in 29 days, macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong USD), zero fundamental conviction, and price at 52-week highs with no smart money alignment.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term bullish structure and extreme fear sentiment present contrarian opportunity, but intermediate momentum overbought with bearish MACD and earnings binary risk in 29 days make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 29 days combined with VIX crisis macro environment and overbought intermediate momentum creates high probability of mean reversion or gap risk before swing target can be reached.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show opportunity, but fundamental weakness and macro risk heavily outweigh bullish signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 20 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration at 77% of portfolio makes additional sizing unjustifiable despite technical setup.
